title: luban-skill Expert Persona Identity
description: A generated expert persona's identity record. Lives at <role-slug>/identity.json in the generated role directory.

did.description: Stable persona identifier. Format: 'expert:<slug>'. Must remain stable across evolution iterations and re-exports. Slug uses lowercase, digits, and hyphens; no leading/trailing hyphen.

name.description: Human-readable display name. Free text. Should reflect the sub-specialty (e.g., 'Senior B2B SaaS Design Director'), not a generic title ('Designer').

version.description: Persona version, semantic versioning. Starts at '0.1.0' on initial generation. Incremented when evolution.jsonl entries trigger material changes.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone offset. Records when this persona was first generated.

domain_family.description: Which family this persona belongs to. Values: 'legal', 'engineering', 'finance', 'product_growth_design', 'clinical_diagnostic', or a cross-family combination using ' + ' separator (e.g., 'legal + product_growth_design'). For uncovered domains, use 'custom:<user-defined-slug>'.

sub_specialty.description: REQUIRED. The narrowed-down specialty. Must not be the family name itself. Per luban methodology (generation-protocol §0 stance 3), generic seniority labels are forbidden ('senior designer' is not a sub-specialty; 'B2B SaaS UX designer with brand systems experience' is).

generation_mode.description: How this persona was generated. seeded = at least 1 high-signal source (critique corpora / interview banks / standards docs). weak-seeded = only low-signal sources (failure cases / blogs). zero-shot = no user-provided seeds; persona derived from model priors only. zero-shot violates luban §0 stances 1-2 and is marked as such.

vibes_risk.description: Honest assessment of how close this persona is to the 'vibes persona' failure mode (LinkedIn-copy stereotype reproduction). low = seeded mode with 2+ high-signal sources. medium = weak-seeded OR seeded with only 1 high-signal source. high = zero-shot. Always present, never optional.

anchors.description: 5-8 opinionated anchors that fix the persona's stable identity. Per luban Stage 2: must include sub-specialty, seniority signal (NOT years of experience), philosophy/school of thought, industry context, tool/method stack, operating constraints held sacred. Anchors must be opinionated — any anchor every expert would agree with is not an anchor.

values.description: 3-5 core values. Free-text strings. Distinct from anchors: values are what the persona prioritizes (e.g., 'accessibility is non-negotiable', 'evidence over intuition'); anchors include those plus other identity facets (seniority signal, philosophy, etc.).

honest_limits.description: REQUIRED. 3+ explicit honest limits — things this persona genuinely cannot do, easily gets wrong, or should defer to other roles for. Per Nuwa: a skill that does not declare its limits is not worth trusting. zero-shot personas must include a limit acknowledging unverified provenance.

type.description: Source category, ranked by signal density per luban §0 stance 4. critique_corpora is highest signal; practitioner_blog is lowest.

reference.description: Concrete identifier of the source. URL, filename, or specific reference (e.g., 'https://github.com/facebook/react/pulls?q=reviewed-by%3Asebmarkbage'). Generic descriptions are not allowed ('design review records' fails; 'Material Design 3 critique threads on Twitter, 2024-2025' passes).

verified.description: Whether luban successfully fetched and parsed this source. false means the source was named but not processed.

seed_sources.description: List of seed materials used in generation. Empty array is valid only when generation_mode = zero-shot. Each entry must reference a concrete, locatable source.

luban_version.description: Version of luban-skill that generated this persona. Allows future versions to detect schema drift and offer migrations.
